description: This file defines a readonly struct in the PdfSharp.Internal namespace called SyMsg, which represents a system message with an identifier and message text, including properties to retrieve event-related information.

classes.name: SyMsg
classes.description: A readonly structure encapsulating a system message with an identifier and message text, providing properties for event ID and event name.

methods.name: SyMsg
methods.description: Constructor initializing the SyMsg struct with an identifier and message string.

methods.name: EventId
methods.description: Returns an EventId object constructed from the message's ID and EventName.

methods.name: EventName
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the message ID.
